comment: The new simplified compliance framework is absolutely outstanding and greatly reduces procedural paperwork.
We strongly support these positive governance reforms; they make board oversight much better and clearer.
Excessive compliance burden and harsh fines make small business operations very difficult.
Penalty structure under Section 454 is overly punitive and needs rationalization.
Vague reporting timelines create severe implementation ambiguity across corporate secretarial teams.
Excellent amendment in revised draft that provides tremendous clarity and beneficial provisions for all companies.
We commend the Ministry for this very helpful and constructive policy revision.
Compliance requirements are simplified in v2.0, but penalty thresholds remain somewhat unclear.
Implementation timelines have been clarified effectively in this revised draft.
Penalty amounts are still somewhat high for minor procedural non-compliances.
Highly effective and fair regulations that support MSMEs and startups perfectly.
A wonderful and transparent step forward for Indian corporate governance.
Penalty structure is now reasonable and well balanced in version 3.
Compliance burden has been resolved satisfactorily following industry stakeholder feedback.
Clear, transparent, and robust governance framework welcomed by industry.
